papers.title: PointRend: Image Segmentation As Rendering
papers.mechanism: uncertainty-guided point rendering with coarse and fine features
papers.evidence: crisper boundaries and gains on COCO and Cityscapes
papers.architecture_similarity_difference: addresses coarse-grid boundary undersampling; adds an adaptive point path unlike current Gaussian/bilinear expansion

papers.title: Masked-attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation
papers.evidence: strong semantic, instance, and panoptic segmentation results
papers.architecture_similarity_difference: spatially restricts attention; current DFG has no predicted-mask support and is not a query-mask decoder

papers.title: Glancing at the Patch: Anomaly Localization With Global and Local Feature Comparison
papers.mechanism: separate local patch and surrounding global context with inconsistency/distortion heads
papers.evidence: improved anomaly localization on industrial benchmarks
papers.architecture_similarity_difference: shares local-context motivation; current S2-LOCR acts on near logits and current families can couple Stage 2 to Stage 3
